import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/project')
from modules import byte_program as bp
from modules.capture_audit import parse_requests, Budget
def check(data, label):
    r,e = parse_requests(bp.literal(data), Budget())
    print(label, '->', ('%d reqs' % len(r)) if r else '', e)
# exact block boundary: 16 + (L+2) + 2 == 65536 -> L = 65516
for L in (65515, 65516, 65517):
    data = b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\n' + b'X:' + b'a'*(L-2) + b'\r\n' + b'\r\n'
    check(data, 'block line content %d (block=%d)' % (L, 16+L+2+2))
# field count boundary
for nf in (127,128,129):
    data = b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\n' + b''.join(b'X: v\r\n' for _ in range(nf)) + b'\r\n'
    check(data, 'fields %d' % nf)
# trailer block boundary
for nf in (128,129):
    data = (b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\r\n\r\n0\r\n' +
            b''.join(b'T: v\r\n' for _ in range(nf)) + b'\r\n')
    check(data, 'trailer fields %d' % nf)

for nm in (b'Host', b'host', b'CONTENT-LENGTH', b'transfer-encoding', b'Ok'):
    data = b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\r\n\r\n0\r\n' + nm + b': v\r\n\r\n'
    check(data, 'trailer name %r' % nm)
